metadata.notes: Official 11-Sep-2026 Z.1 release. Treasury table F3.2.s (formerly L.210). Parent totals and subcategories coexist and must not all be summed. Market-value holdings differ from face-value federal debt. Original ND/NA missing markers retained. Transactions are separately provided as NSA and SAAR; source quarter labels retained.
